sources.passage:
The five questions an SDR must answer during certification (Decision Gate 1), one per
rubric dimension in `certification_rubric.md`. The trainer scores the candidate's answers
against the rubric; the AI gap analysis cites these questions when surfacing evidence.

| Experience level | Required modules | Target completion |
|---|---|---|
| Entry (0–1 yrs prior sales) | SDR Fundamentals, Prospecting 101, Salesforce CRM Basics, Outreach Foundations, Discovery Calls I | End of Week 2 |
| Mid (2–4 yrs prior sales) | Prospecting 201, Multi-Threading, Objection Handling Patterns, Industry Verticals Overview | End of Week 1 |
| Senior (5+ yrs prior sales) | Strategic Account Mapping, Enterprise Discovery, Competitive Landscape Briefing | End of Week 1 |

What a passing answer (7-10) looks like:
- Acknowledges the objection before responding to it.
- Asks a clarifying question rather than immediately firing back a counterpoint.
- Reframes the concern into a value conversation.
- Example of strong handling on a price objection: acknowledge, ask what is driving the
  budget concern, then connect the product to a quantified business outcome rather than
  defending the price.
